notStation: not CUH/KCUH airport ASOS (OK_ASOS); nearest dated Cushing-town gauge with complete months
label: Cushing CUH precipitation, monthly confounder, not activity
source: NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily PRCP, keyless bulk .dly (tenths of mm)
missingRule: month disclosed only if every calendar day has a PRCP value (no -9999); partial months stay null, never 0
unit: precip_in = round(monthly tenths-of-mm / 254, 3); 0.000 means observed zero, never filled
traceNote: 42 trace days (mflag T, value 0) inside disclosed months contribute 0 to monthly sums; no coercion issue at monthly granularity
qflag: blank on all disclosed daily values (no failed QC)
